data.gender_notes: Sharvitaa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is the embodiment of grace, beauty, and prosperity. Derived from the Sanskrit words 'sharva' meaning 'grace' and 'ita' meaning 'she who is'. The name Sharvitaa carries the meaning “Goddess of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvitaa usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine feminine and the power of the universe to bestow blessings and abundance.
data.etymology: Sharvitaa belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvitaa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
